epistemic_policy: Reported values and graph relationships are facts only when directly cited; causal links remain inference or hypothesis and review_status pending.

demand_driver.value: DRAM / HBM and at-speed HBM stack testing
demand_driver.evidence: Management reported record DRAM probe-card revenue, a second SmartMatrix customer increasing adoption, and another HBM-led DRAM record expected in Q2.

earnings_driver.affected_metric: Probe Cards segment revenue and gross margin
earnings_driver.evidence: 2026Q1 Probe Cards revenue was USD 198.257m and segment gross margin 50.51%; HBM attribution is supported separately by management commentary.
earnings_driver.counter_evidence: Foundry/Logic and NAND demand also contribute, so HBM is not isolated.

metric.evidence: investment-kg five-quarter financial and inventory reads.

graph_path.path: FormFactor -[EXPOSED_TO]-> DRAM / HBM; FormFactor -[PRODUCES]-> Probe Card
graph_path.evidence: Fresh live Neo4j read returned both sourced relationships; no Wafer Test Cell relationship was returned.

bottleneck.mechanism: At-speed full-wafer HBM stack contactor adoption must qualify and scale across customers before demand converts fully into probe-card revenue.
bottleneck.evidence: Only the second-customer adoption statement is factual; qualification as the limiting mechanism is analytical.
bottleneck.counter_evidence: Record DRAM revenue and expected Q2 growth indicate the constraint may already be easing.

beneficiary.mechanism: More qualified SmartMatrix customers can raise Probe Cards volume and mix, improving segment revenue and potentially gross margin.
beneficiary.evidence: Second-customer adoption and HBM-led outlook connect qualification to sales opportunity.
beneficiary.counter_evidence: Failure to broaden adoption or weaker HBM demand would break the link.

link_expansion.candidate: SmartMatrix full-wafer contactor adoption by additional HBM customers
link_expansion.why_connected: It is the named interface technology for at-speed HBM stack testing.
link_expansion.existing_evidence: Management reported a second customer increasing adoption.
link_expansion.source_needed: Subsequent FORM earnings call or filing with customer count and revenue contribution.
link_expansion.recheck_reason: The official transcript-derived commentary directly reports adoption expansion, but economics remain unquantified.

demand_driver.evidence: Fresh live Neo4j read returned sourced HBM exposure, Wafer Test Cell operation and Probe Card production.

earnings_driver.affected_metric: Probe Card and Interface Board product revenue
earnings_driver.evidence: 2026Q1 product revenue was KRW 47,867m Probe Card and KRW 40,003m Interface Board; causal HBM allocation is not disclosed.
earnings_driver.counter_evidence: Test Socket and OLED inspection equipment make the consolidated earnings bridge non-exclusive.

metric.evidence: investment-kg five-quarter financial and inventory reads.

graph_path.path: 티에스이 -[EXPOSED_TO]-> DRAM / HBM; -[OPERATES_IN]-> Wafer Test Cell; -[PRODUCES]-> Probe Card, Test Socket, Interface Board
graph_path.evidence: Fresh live Neo4j read returned all relationships.

bottleneck.mechanism: Rapid inventory build may be required to support the multi-interface product ramp, but can become a conversion bottleneck if shipments or qualifications lag.
bottleneck.evidence: Inventory rose 31.42% QoQ while four product groups generated revenue; no explicit capacity constraint was disclosed.
bottleneck.counter_evidence: High Q1 operating margin and revenue growth may mean inventory is deliberate ramp stock rather than a bottleneck.

beneficiary.mechanism: If inventory converts through qualified wafer-test demand, Probe Card and Interface Board sales can lift consolidated revenue and operating leverage.
beneficiary.affected_metric: inventory days/conversion, product revenue, operating margin
beneficiary.evidence: The same filing supplies inventory, earnings and product-revenue facts; conversion is inferred.
beneficiary.counter_evidence: Further inventory growth without matching sales, or product-mix margin dilution, would refute the benefit.

link_expansion.candidate: Interface Board plus Probe Card co-demand in Wafer Test Cell
link_expansion.why_connected: Both are reported product groups and the company is graph-linked to Wafer Test Cell.
link_expansion.existing_evidence: 2026Q1 revenue exists for both product groups; graph sources them to the same filing.
link_expansion.source_needed: Future DART product sales and inventory notes separating shipment and qualification timing.
link_expansion.evidence: Fresh DART-backed structured and graph reads.
link_expansion.recheck_reason: The filing supports a diversified interface mix, weakening a narrow Probe-Card-only constraint; it does not reject a broader working-capital/qualification bottleneck.

demand_driver.value: AI/HPC and DRAM / HBM test-interface demand
demand_driver.evidence: Issuer commentary attributes record results to high-frequency/high-speed AI products and describes capacity as fully loaded.

earnings_driver.affected_metric: Semiconductor Test Interface revenue and operating income
earnings_driver.evidence: 2026Q1 single-segment revenue was TWD 2,980.415m and operating income TWD 776.696m; issuer links record performance to AI product shipments.
earnings_driver.counter_evidence: The source does not quantify HBM-specific revenue and operating margin fell from 2025Q2 levels.

metric.evidence: investment-kg five-quarter financial and inventory reads.

graph_path.path: WinWay -[EXPOSED_TO]-> DRAM / HBM; -[PRODUCES]-> Vertical Probe Card and Test Socket
graph_path.evidence: Fresh live Neo4j read returned the sourced relationships; no Wafer Test Cell edge was returned.

bottleneck.mechanism: Fully loaded test-interface capacity limits shipment conversion until the Renwu leased-factory ramp adds usable output.
bottleneck.evidence: Issuer reported full loading and a ramp from 30% to a targeted 40% of total capacity by 2026-06-30.
bottleneck.counter_evidence: Inventory rose 19.92% QoQ and margin is below 2025Q2, which could indicate demand/mix or ramp inefficiency rather than only capacity scarcity.

beneficiary.mechanism: Successful Renwu qualification and ramp can release the reported capacity constraint, enabling more AI/HPC interface shipments and operating-income growth.
beneficiary.evidence: Issuer connects accelerated ramp to serving AI/HPC customers; benefit magnitude is not disclosed.
beneficiary.counter_evidence: Failure to reach the 40% target, weak customer qualification, or margin dilution would refute the benefit.

link_expansion.candidate: Renwu ramp for AI/HPC semiconductor test interfaces
link_expansion.why_connected: It is the disclosed response to full loading and AI/HPC demand.
link_expansion.existing_evidence: Issuer reports operation from 2026-04-01, 30% reached and 40% target by 2026-06-30.
link_expansion.source_needed: Next WinWay monthly/quarterly official release confirming utilization, target attainment and margin effect.
link_expansion.evidence: Fresh investment-kg capacity and commentary reads.
link_expansion.recheck_reason: The official issuer source explicitly pairs full loading with accelerated capacity ramp and AI/HPC demand.

common_value_chain.chain: DRAM/HBM and AI/HPC demand -> wafer/full-stack test intensity -> probe card/test socket/interface demand -> qualification or capacity constraint -> shipment and margin conversion
common_value_chain.evidence: Triangulated from fresh structured reads and live relationship paths; the cross-company causal synthesis remains inference.
